# IN Cibum - Il magazine dell'accademia di cucina

> > The official magazine of IN Cibum culinary academy, featuring chef interviews, recipes, training guides, and exclusive food education content.

IN Cibum is a culinary academy magazine dedicated to Italian cuisine, professional chef training, and food education. The platform publishes interviews with renowned chefs, cooking techniques, pastry and pizza-making guides, and student success stories from the academy.

## Key Topics

- IN Cibum
- Italian Cuisine
- Culinary Academy
- Chef Training
- Cooking Recipes
- Pastry & Baking
- Pizza Making
- Food Education
- Career Guides
- Student Stories
- Bake Off Italia
- Claudio Castaldo
- Imma Lopez
- Food News
- UNESCO

## Culinary Academy & Training

- [IL magazine dell'accademia di cucina IN Cibum](https://blog.incibum.it): IN Cibum culinary academy magazine with chef interviews, news and exclusive content
